nodes.label: NoDoomScroll App Branding Identity
nodes.rationale: Branding uses a green background with white Android-inspired robot head silhouette. Design emphasizes digital nature and accessibility. Multiple density variants (hdpi, mdpi, xhdpi, xxhdpi, xxxhdpi) support responsive icon rendering across Android device screens.

nodes.label: Custom Apps Irreversibility Constraint
nodes.rationale: Once a custom app is added to the blocklist, it cannot be removed while NoDoomScroll is installed. This is an intentional permanent constraint.

nodes.label: Mode Libre Button States in Overlay
nodes.norm_label: mode libre button states in overlay
nodes.rationale: The Mode Libre button displays different states: available, in cooldown with countdown, quota exhausted, outside time window, or hidden if not configured. States change based on configuration and current time.

nodes.label: Grayscale Mode Permission Requirement
nodes.rationale: Grayscale mode requires WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS permission which needs ADB configuration. Toggle is disabled and greyed out until permission is granted.

nodes.label: Locked Configuration Section
nodes.rationale: Mode Libre and Weekly Report settings configured during onboarding are displayed read-only with a 'Locked' badge, emphasizing they cannot be modified after initial setup.

nodes.label: Widget Data Display Elements
nodes.rationale: Widget displays three key metrics: streak counter (days), time saved today, and Mode Libre status with color-coded indicator. Data must be real-time and reliable.
